notes.title: Deep Deep Deep Nightmare is available!
notes.content:
[b]Today... the nightmare begins.[/b]

We’re proud (and a little creeped out) to announce that [b]Deep Deep Deep Nightmare[/b] is officially [b]out now[/b] on Steam!

Price: [b]$10 USD[/b], [b]but you can purchase with 20% OFF during the launch![/b]

[previewyoutube=YVMPkcB3QP8;full][/previewyoutube]

Step into a haunting 2D Top Down Shooter where survival means facing twisted monsters spawned from a child’s worst fear.

You play as a little boy who ignored his mom’s warnings: never go to bed on a full stomach… unless you want to get lost in the nightmare.

[b]Face the fear. Fight your way out. And whatever you do—don’t wake up screaming.[/b]

[b]Steam Deck compatible[/b] – runs like a dream (or should we say... a nightmare).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718611/42c03fc596ab87057991fd49d09b4e7455cb709d.png[/img]

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/qubyte]community on Discord[/url], share your gameplay, and let us know how far you got before the shadows took over.

Thank you all for your incredible support during the demo phase. Now…

[b]Deep Deep Deep Nightmare awaits.[/b]

notes.title: Launching April 24th!
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

We are thrilled to announce the release date of Deep Deep Deep Nightmare! The game will launch on [b]April 24th[/b] and will be priced at [b]$10 USD.[/b]

Prepare yourself for an intense horror experience like no other! Deep Deep Deep Nightmare will be available on Steam and is [b]compatible with the Steam Deck[/b]. The game runs great on Deck, with only minor adjustments planned for a future update.

[previewyoutube=fcMjB9Z1DdU;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re eager to hear your thoughts and experiences! Join our community on Discord to share your feedback and discuss all things Deep Deep Deep Nightmare. Your support means everything to us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718611/42c03fc596ab87057991fd49d09b4e7455cb709d.png[/img]

Thank you all for playing the demo and for your amazing support. We can’t wait for you to dive into the nightmare on April 24th!

notes.title: Deep Deep Deep Nightmare in the Made in Brazil Sale!
notes.content:
Hey, everyone 👁

We bring a message from the depths: From today until [b]March 4th[/b], Deep Deep Deep Nightmare is part of the [b]Made in Brazil Sale[/b], a event featuring incredible Brazilian games! 

[b]In Deep Deep Deep Nightmare, you will face:[/b]

👹 Relentless hordes of monsters and deadly traps
🕷 Multiple battles against terrifying bosses
🔮 Collect souls to acquire weapons and spells from the shadowy shop
⚔️ Weapons and magic with unique and devastating effects
🗡️ Equip up to 4 weapons to annihilate your enemies
📜 Cast mystical spells to turn the tide in battle

See you in the darkness...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718611/43f85095b9e724a0f1a8dd6eff4906a107eba15d.jpg[/img]
